name: SK Innovation Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Innovation Co., Ltd., a prominent global energy and chemical enterprise headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, operates across diverse sectors including Petroleum, Petrochemicals, Lubricants, Battery technology, LiBS, and other ventures. Established in 1962 and formerly known as SK Energy Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in January 2011, the company engages in the exploration and production of crude oil, alongside the refining and import of crude oil and naphtha to produce a variety of fuels such as gasoline, diesel, and kerosene. Its chemical and materials portfolio extends to base oils, lubricants, fundamental chemicals, asphalt, chemical solvents, and synthetic rubber products. A significant part of its business involves the comprehensive manufacturing of lithium batteries, from electrodes and separators to complete cells, packs, and modules, which are critical components for electric vehicles, UPS systems, and renewable energy grids. Furthermore, the company offers an array of supplementary services, including business consulting, insurance, manufacturing, transportation, trading, equity investments, and specialized certification and evaluation for its battery products.
